newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - APRIL 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - APRIL 25.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the April 26 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The State Duma, lower house of the Russian parliament, postponed on Friday ratification of an international treaty banning chemical weapons. The Duma's intransigence could end up bringing international sanctions on Russia, the paper says.
- Ukrainian President Leonid Kuchma says there is no problem over the status of Sevastopol, the disputed site of the Black Sea Fleet. But Moscow does not agree.
- The Russian government and Central Bank are to sign a join statement on the 1997 economic policy.

- The authorities in Taganrog, a port on the Azov Sea, proposed that a controversial new monument to the Russian tsar Peter the Great be transferred from Moscow to their town, which was founded by the tsar.
